desc:
🔱 Throw your spear across the sea and see what you catch!

🎯 Tap at the right moment to throw. The further your spear flies, the luckier your catch gets. Every biome it crosses boosts your luck, from Tropical Shore all the way to the Primordial Sea 🌊 When it lands, a fish bursts out of the water. Will it be a Common catch or a 1 in a million Secret? 🍀

🐠 Show off your fish in your aquarium and watch the money roll in, even while you're offline.

💪 Do pull-ups to get stronger and throw even further. Upgrade your bar from Wood to Genesis, unlock 30 legendary spears for more luck and expand your aquarium to fit more fish.

🎁 Gift fish to your friends, chat across servers and see every rare catch in Global Alerts!

🗺️ 20 biomes to reach
🐟 290+ fish across 12 rarities, from Common to Secret
